Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Economics BA at Emory University

What Emory University asks of applicants to Economics BA for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

US · All Emory University courses · Economics & Finance field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 7 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • Test-optional for the 2026–27 application cycle (fall 2027 entry) — SAT/ACT not required
  • Scores, if submitted, may be self-reported or sent officially
Verified19 Oct 2026Emory: Standardized Exam Policies · Emory: First-Year Applicants
English language
  • Applicants whose primary language is not English must demonstrate English proficiency
  • Met by SAT EBRW 700+, ACT English 30+, or the most recent four years in an English-medium school; otherwise one of TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo English Test is required
  • Recommended scores (not strict cutoffs): TOEFL iBT 100 (old scale) or 5.5+ (new scale); IELTS 7.5

Emory publishes only a competitive-applicant figure for Duolingo (above 130), not a minimum score, so no Duolingo score is shown as a requirement. Emory’s First-Year page labels “TOEFL or IELTS” as “(Recommended)”, while the Standardized Exam Policies page says an exam “is required” unless one of the listed criteria is met; the stricter, more detailed exam-policy page is followed here.

Verified19 Oct 2026Emory: Standardized Exam Policies
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

Verified19 Oct 2026Emory: First-Year Applicants
Subject prerequisites
  • Not used in Altiora’s matching yet — see the note for the official guidance

Official (Oxford College catalog — applies to applicants to Oxford College, one of the two colleges first-year applicants can apply to): at least sixteen acceptable units; Oxford strongly recommends English 4, Mathematics (including Algebra II) 4, Foreign language 2, Social studies 3, Laboratory sciences 3. Emory’s admissions pages (apply.emory.edu) state no high-school course requirements or recommendations for Emory College applicants.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Emory Oxford College Catalog: Admission · Emory: First-Year Applicants

Not recorded
Details
Emory’s international admissions page names the British A-Level system among curricula “widely recognized as competitive, regardless of country”.

No page states how A-Level grades (predicted or final) are submitted or what grades are expected.

Not recorded
Details
The IB Diploma is named among curricula “widely recognized as competitive”; applicants are encouraged to self-report IB exam scores, and official results are not needed at the time of application.
Verified19 Oct 2026Emory: International Applicants · Emory: Standardized Exam Policies
Other qualifications
  • AP exam scores:
    • all applicants encouraged to self-report scores of 3 or higher (optional)
    • official AP reports required only if admitted and enrolling
Verified19 Oct 2026Emory: Standardized Exam Policies
Other requirements
  • Required: Common App personal statement and two Emory-specific short-answer questions
  • No evaluative interviews with admission staff or alumni; international applicants may optionally submit an InitialView interview
  • Apply to Emory College, Oxford College, or both

Emory’s FAQ also mentions “feedback from the Alumni Interview program” in its test-optional answer, which sits oddly with its statement that it does not offer alumni interviews.
